The Recruitment List Tools allow you to maintain an email list of potential prospects for yourLeague. You can add, edit and delete names from the list, audit the email addresses for validity and send bulk mailings out to this list inviting them to register for your league.

The Player Registration Tools allow you to register a player or a group for your league, edit or delete player registrations, mark receipt of waivers and payments, audit email addressesand send bulk messages out to the players and their families. You can use this tool to sendreminders to those with incomplete registrations as well as to send personal Player dashboardsto those who have lost theirs.

The Set up Teams and Coaches link lets you add, edit or delete team names, gather contactinformation on your coaches, and assign coaches to individual teams.

You may use the Assign Players to Teams link to move players onto teams using a drag-and-drop tool that lets you see basic player information, such as sex, age and friends.

The Order Uniforms link will give you size breakouts for uniforms for all of your registered players.If you use divisions, it will break them out by division.

The final link, Send Dashboards to Coaches, permits you to send out a bulk mailing to all ofyour coaches, giving them their team assignments and providing each with a personal Coach'sDashboard with a set of tools to help them manage their team.

In Register a Player or Group, you may enter registration information directly, send someone a direct link to the registration form for them to fill out, or do a group registration.

You may use View all registrations to access several summary view of all the registrations forms. You may sort any view by the responses in any column just by clicking on the heading for that column.

View/Edit a specific registration permits you to access any player's registration form in order to view it or correct information.

Delete a registration is useful to remove a record entirely. The is especially valuable when registrants inadvertently end up with duplicate records in the database.

Audit registration email addresses checks the addresses in all the registrations for validity. It can catch common typos and misspellings, although it doesn't catch everything.

With Communicate with registered players, you are able to send bulk mailings to all players, to those missing waivers, to those who have not yet paid and to those whose registrations are complete in all respects.

With Payment report you can see the list of players whose registrations are paid, including the payment amounts and payment methods.
